component.name: Go for It Qt
component.summary: To-do list with built-in productivity timer, SQLite storage, and Jira/YouTrack sync

description.p: Go for It Qt is a modern C++20 / Qt 6 productivity application combining task management with a Pomodoro timer.

ul.li: Single-file SQLite storage with backup export/import and customizable path
Native Jira (Cloud / Data Center) and JetBrains YouTrack issue synchronization
5 local workflow statuses (To-Do, In Progress, Paused, Done, Canceled/Rejected) with remote status mapping
Full task description and comments viewer
Automatic Pomodoro worklog / workItem time logging to Jira and YouTrack
